research_scope: Long-horizon SPY direction and risk-scaling research; this is separate from the shorter historical options execution-proxy replay.

protocol.execution_lag: signal at adjusted close t; rebalance at adjusted close t+1; exposure first earns adjusted close-to-close return t+1 to t+2
protocol.cash_return_assumption: observed adjusted BIL close-to-close return; no synthetic interest rate
protocol.preregistered_candidate_definition: Equal-weight positive-trend fraction across 21-, 63-, and 252-session SPY-minus-BIL return horizons, multiplied by an unlevered 10% 20-session SPY realized-volatility target; unallocated exposure earns the observed BIL return.
protocol.selection_rule: The preregistered candidate is fixed from the cited literature before economic results are computed. It proceeds to the final holdout only if validation return and BIL-excess Sharpe are positive, validation has at least 252 observations, average exposure is at least 5%, and it has either lower volatility or shallower drawdown than buy-and-hold. All other candidates are diagnostics and cannot be selected.
protocol.holdout_rule: The preregistered candidate ID and validation gate are instantiated in a hashed selection receipt before the dated final holdout is sliced or scored.
protocol.claim_boundary: A positive historical holdout is evidence about this fixed sample and cost model, not proof of durable alpha, live options profitability, or future returns.

sources.title: Time Series Momentum
sources.authors: Tobias J. Moskowitz, Yao Hua Ooi, and Lasse Heje Pedersen
sources.design_use: Fixed 1- to 12-month time-series trend horizons; Finly uses long-only, unlevered variants rather than claiming to reproduce the paper's diversified futures portfolio.

sources.title: A Century of Evidence on Trend-Following Investing
sources.authors: Brian Hurst, Yao Hua Ooi, and Lasse Heje Pedersen
sources.design_use: Predeclared equal combination of 1-, 3-, and 12-month trend horizons with volatility scaling; Finly applies a long-only, unlevered single-index adaptation.

sources.title: Volatility-Managed Portfolios
sources.design_use: Inverse-volatility risk scaling; Finly caps exposure at one and does not use leverage.

sources.title: The Deflated Sharpe Ratio: Correcting for Selection Bias, Backtest Overfitting, and Non-Normality
sources.authors: David H. Bailey and Marcos López de Prado
sources.design_use: Non-normality-aware probabilistic and deflated Sharpe falsification with an explicitly disclosed trial count.

sources.title: A Reality Check for Data Snooping
sources.design_use: Centered shared-block maximum-statistic bootstrap across the disclosed economic candidate family.

sources.title: Alpaca Market Data API
sources.design_use: Read-only adjusted daily delayed SIP bars and explicit data-plan boundary.

evaluation_order.claim_boundary: Control flow prevents final-holdout rows from entering training, validation, or selection. The separate git preregistration commits predate report generation; the in-memory receipt is not a cryptographic proof that a researcher never viewed the historical dates.

block_bootstrap.method: deterministic circular block bootstrap of daily net returns

quarter_fold_evidence.fold_definition: calendar quarters with at least twenty scored sessions

probabilistic_deflated_sharpe.method: Bailey-Lopez de Prado probabilistic Sharpe ratio and deflated Sharpe ratio
probabilistic_deflated_sharpe.claim_boundary: These fixed-sample probabilities are model-based falsification evidence, not formal proof of alpha, independence, stationarity, or future profitability.

reference_formulae.probabilistic_sharpe: Phi((SR_hat - SR_benchmark) * sqrt(n - 1) / sqrt(1 - skewness * SR_hat + ((Pearson_kurtosis - 1) / 4) * SR_hat^2))
reference_formulae.deflated_benchmark: mean_trial_SR + sd_trial_SR * ((1 - EulerGamma) * Phi^-1(1 - 1 / N) + EulerGamma * Phi^-1(1 - 1 / (N * e)))

probabilistic_deflated_sharpe.trial_count_requirement: Declared explicitly by the caller and no smaller than the candidate IDs supplied to this calculation.
probabilistic_deflated_sharpe.excess_return_definition: candidate daily net_return minus the same row's adjusted BIL cash_return

observed_candidate.moment_estimator: uncorrected central moments with denominator n; kurtosis is Pearson kurtosis, not excess kurtosis

assumptions: The probabilistic Sharpe approximation uses IID asymptotics after adjusting its variance for the fixed candidate's return skewness and Pearson kurtosis.

The deflated benchmark treats the declared N trials as independent and estimates their Sharpe mean and dispersion from the supplied candidate IDs; it does not estimate an effective trial count from candidate correlation.
Daily arithmetic BIL-excess returns and 252 periods per year are used unless the caller explicitly supplies another annualization frequency.

circular_block_reality_check.method: White-style centered circular-block bootstrap of the maximum BIL-excess sample mean
circular_block_reality_check.claim_boundary: This deterministic resampling result is falsification evidence under the stated centering and block assumptions; it is not a formal proof of alpha, stationarity, or future profitability.
circular_block_reality_check.null_hypothesis: Every supplied candidate has population mean daily BIL-excess return less than or equal to zero.
circular_block_reality_check.alternative: At least one supplied candidate has positive population mean daily BIL-excess return.
circular_block_reality_check.fixed_candidate_alternative: Candidate tsmom_ensemble_vol has positive population mean daily BIL-excess return.
circular_block_reality_check.statistic: sqrt(n) multiplied by the arithmetic mean daily BIL-excess return; the familywise statistic is the maximum across candidates
circular_block_reality_check.centering: Each candidate series is demeaned separately before bootstrap sampling to impose a zero-mean null.
circular_block_reality_check.block_sampling: Every iteration draws circular blocks of row indexes and applies the identical sampled index path to all candidate series, preserving contemporaneous cross-candidate dependence within sampled blocks.
circular_block_reality_check.p_value_estimator: (1 + bootstrap exceedances) / (iterations + 1); one-sided, with equality counted as an exceedance
circular_block_reality_check.excess_return_definition: candidate daily net_return minus the same row's adjusted BIL cash_return
assumptions: Circular blocks approximate serial dependence only up to the caller-selected block length.
The same sampled blocks across candidates preserve their observed contemporaneous and within-block dependence rather than treating strategy trials as independent.
The familywise p-value addresses the supplied candidate family only; omitted or undisclosed trials are not corrected.

interpretation: The selected deterministic policy earned a fixed-sample historical result after modeled stock turnover costs. This can support a bounded direction/risk layer. It cannot establish live options fills, causal value from an LLM, persistent alpha, or future profitability.
next_proof: Run the frozen policy prospectively in Alpaca paper trading, keep the options execution overlay separately scored, and do not revise the policy using the dated final holdout.
